# `kll_sketch_get_quantile_float`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Extracts a single value from the quantiles sketch representing the
desired quantile given the input rank. The desired quantile can either be a single value
or an array. In the latter case, the function will return an array of results of equal
length to the input array.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
kll_sketch_get_quantile_float(left, right)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- kll_sketch_get_quantile_float, example 1
> SELECT kll_sketch_get_quantile_float(kll_sketch_agg_float(col), 0.5) > 1 FROM VALUES (CAST(1.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(2.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(3.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(4.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(5.0 AS FLOAT)) tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
